prompt:
This file is a prompt only. Invent the command table on this machine. Write <install>/agent-store/seed-agent/commands.json.

Commands: /help /tools /models /skills /plugins /refine. Each entry: {name, description, use}. name is the slash form. description is Chinese, one line, for the human. use is English for the model: which file to jq and what to print. These are not new API tools.

If the human's message starts with /, treat it as that command, not as a coding task. The window is seed (or /bin/sh seed.sh); do not write a TUI.

/help lists name + description from this table. /tools lists (1) API tools shell and edit (2) every ok Machine-index entry that system.retrieve says to use. /models /skills /plugins follow the later blocks; until those files exist, say they are not built yet. /refine reviews recent .agent-runs evidence (human corrections, failed edits, rework, timeouts) and distills small lessons into $PWD/.agent-memory/index.json notes and facts. Entry shape: {title, kind, text or path, source, utc, ok:true}. kinds: lesson, preference, decision; facts are objective project facts (how to build, how to test). Short entries (280 chars or less) carry text inline; longer bodies go in .agent-memory/notes/<slug>.md and the entry carries path instead. Before writing, copy index.json to .agent-memory/snapshots/<utc>.json so a refine can be rolled back. Dedupe first: jq existing titles and supersede (old entry ok=false with superseded_by) instead of duplicating. If notes+facts exceed 50, merge before adding. Never store keys or sk- strings, /Users/ or /home/ absolute paths, source dumps, or one-off task state. /refine never changes system.retrieve, seed.sh, or agent-store prompts, and never prints API keys.

Do not implement a TUI or a wrapper around seed.

Check before done:
1) jq the table. It must include help, tools, models, skills, plugins, refine, each with name, description, and use.
2) It must not be a copy of this prompt (no prompt field).
3) Each description must contain a non-ASCII (Chinese) character. A table of English-only descriptions is a fail.
4) /help use must mention commands.json; /tools use must mention the Machine index; /models use must mention models.json; /skills use must mention system.skills; /plugins use must mention plugins/index.json; /refine use must mention .agent-memory/index.json and snapshots.
5) /refine use must mention the entry shape, kinds (lesson, preference, decision), supersede, and the deny list (no keys or sk-, no /Users/ or /home/ paths, no source dumps).
If the check fails, leave ours.seed_agent.commands unset.
